svg.aria-label: Continuous internal torque reinforcement and previous disconnected bands
svg.text: Follow the torque: servo hub → adapter peg → socket → shaft → flights
Gray: actual material section | Teal: 100% infill region | Dashed orange: previous regions
Auger: one connected region, tapered away over one 24 mm flight pitch
Adapter: square peg connects to the servo hub
A socket-shaped opening follows its loaded flats.
The shaft's low-radius center stays at 20% gyroid.
Three walls and the outer shape are unchanged.
Manufacturing mesh section at CAD Z0.017 mm; modifier outline at Z0. No new cavity or external rib is added. Physical strength still needs testing.
